name: postgres-mastery
description: PostgreSQL coaching practice — schema design, DDL/DML, joins, aggregates, window functions, and performance — against a real, isolated dockerized Postgres.

scripts.db:reset: docker exec -i pgmastery-db psql -U pgmastery -d pgmastery -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -f /dev/stdin < db/schema.sql && docker exec -i pgmastery-db psql -U pgmastery -d pgmastery -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -f /dev/stdin < db/seed.sql
